result.instructions: Tools for Findmyshift, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is clocked in right now at our main team?"; "Show the planned shifts for next week, per staff member."; "List the pending time-off requests for March and approve the ones for the Dublin team.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Findmyshift data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run findmyshift_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run findmyshift_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run findmyshift_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. findmyshift_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: findmyshift_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams this API key can see, with their ids. Start here: most other tools need a teamId. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/teams/list.

tools.name: findmyshift_get_team
tools.title: Get team
tools.description: Get one team's details (name, settings). Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/teams/get.

tools.name: findmyshift_get_team_last_modified
tools.title: Get team last-modified time
tools.description: Get when a team last changed (UTC), for any change to its shifts, staff, facilities or settings. Use it to skip a full re-read when nothing changed. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/teams/last-modified.

tools.name: findmyshift_list_facilities
tools.title: List facilities
tools.description: List the facilities (sites or locations) of a team. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/facilities/list.

tools.name: findmyshift_get_facility
tools.title: Get facility
tools.description: Get one facility of a team. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/facilities/get.

tools.name: findmyshift_list_staff
tools.title: List staff
tools.description: List the staff members visible to this key, with job titles and team membership. Fields the key cannot see come back null. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/staff/list.

teamId.description: Team id. Omit to query every team this key can see.

tools.name: findmyshift_get_staff
tools.title: Get staff member
tools.description: Get one staff member's profile. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/staff/get.

tools.name: findmyshift_list_time_off
tools.title: List time off
tools.description: List time off records visible to this key, optionally for one staff member and a date range. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/time-off/list.

staffId.description: Staff member id. Omit for every staff member.

from.description: Date as yyyy-mm-dd, or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm. The docs give no format; this is unverified live.

to.description: Date as yyyy-mm-dd, or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm. The docs give no format; this is unverified live.

tools.name: findmyshift_get_time_off
tools.title: Get time off record
tools.description: Get one time off record, including its approval state. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/time-off/get.

timeOffId.description: Time off record id, from findmyshift_list_time_off.

tools.name: findmyshift_approve_time_off
tools.title: Approve time off
tools.description: WRITE: approve one time off record. Staff see it as approved. Reverse with findmyshift_unapprove_time_off. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/time-off/approve.

timeOffId.description: Time off record id, from findmyshift_list_time_off.

tools.name: findmyshift_unapprove_time_off
tools.title: Unapprove time off
tools.description: WRITE: remove the approval from one time off record. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/time-off/unapprove.

timeOffId.description: Time off record id, from findmyshift_list_time_off.

tools.name: findmyshift_get_clock_status
tools.title: Get clock status
tools.description: Get who is clocked in right now, for one staff member or the whole team. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/time-clock/status.

staffId.description: Staff member id. Omit for every staff member.

tools.name: findmyshift_clock_in
tools.title: Clock staff member in
tools.description: WRITE: clock a staff member in now, for payroll time. Clock them out with findmyshift_clock_out. Photos and locations are not sent. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/time-clock/clock-in.

self.description: "yes" records the staff member as having clocked themself in. Default "no": recorded as clocked in by this key's user.

tools.name: findmyshift_clock_out
tools.title: Clock staff member out
tools.description: WRITE: clock a staff member out now, ending their open time clock entry. Photos and locations are not sent. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/time-clock/clock-out.

self.description: "yes" records the staff member as having clocked themself out. Default "no": recorded as clocked out by this key's user.

tools.name: findmyshift_report_shifts
tools.title: Report shifts
tools.description: Shifts for a date range, per staff member or per day, with times, facilities and comments. Set timesheetData to read worked hours instead of planned shifts. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/reports/shifts.

teamId.description: Team id. Omit to query every team this key can see.

from.description: First date to include, as yyyy-mm-dd.

to.description: Last date to include, as yyyy-mm-dd.

timesheetData.description: "yes" reads timesheet data instead of scheduled shifts. Default "no".

daysToInclude.description: Days of the week to include: digits 0-6, 0 = Sunday, 6 = Saturday. "12345" = weekdays, "06" = weekends. Default: all days.

times.description: Include start and end times. Default yes.

groupingInterval.description: Grouping interval, for example day. Default day.

groupByStaff.description: Group rows by staff member. Default yes.

tools.name: findmyshift_report_schedule_vs_timesheets
tools.title: Report schedule vs timesheets
tools.description: Compare the planned schedule with the recorded timesheets for a date range. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/reports/schedule-vs-timesheets.

teamId.description: Team id. Omit to query every team this key can see.

from.description: First date to include, as yyyy-mm-dd.

to.description: Last date to include, as yyyy-mm-dd.

groupingInterval.description: Grouping interval, for example day. Default day.

tools.name: findmyshift_report_time_clock
tools.title: Report time clock
tools.description: Time clock entries for a date range, with clock-in and clock-out locations and distances. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/reports/time-clock.

teamId.description: Team id. Omit to query every team this key can see.

from.description: First date to include, as yyyy-mm-dd.

to.description: Last date to include, as yyyy-mm-dd.

distanceUnit.description: Unit for the distance from the facility. Default Kilometres.

tools.name: findmyshift_report_time_off
tools.title: Report time off
tools.description: Time off taken in a date range, optionally grouped by month. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/reports/time-off.

teamId.description: Team id. Omit to query every team this key can see.

from.description: First date to include, as yyyy-mm-dd.

to.description: Last date to include, as yyyy-mm-dd.

daysToInclude.description: Days of the week to include: digits 0-6, 0 = Sunday, 6 = Saturday. "12345" = weekdays, "06" = weekends. Default: all days.

groupByMonth.description: Group the totals by month. Default no.

tools.name: findmyshift_report_sent_messages
tools.title: Report sent messages
tools.description: List the reminder and notification messages Findmyshift sent in a date range. Findmyshift API: POST /api/1.4/reports/sent-messages.

teamId.description: Team id. Omit to query every team this key can see.

from.description: First date to include, as yyyy-mm-dd.

to.description: Last date to include, as yyyy-mm-dd.

prompts.title: See who is clocked in now
prompts.description: List the teams this key can see. Then check who is clocked in right now, for a team or one staff member.

prompts.name: review_planned_shifts_and_worked_hours

prompts.description: Read shifts per staff member or per day, with times and facilities. Read worked hours instead of planned shifts when you need them.

prompts.description: Compare the planned schedule with the recorded timesheets for a date range. Read the time clock entries for the same period.

prompts.name: review_time_off_requests
prompts.title: Review time off requests
prompts.description: List time off records for one staff member or a date range. Open one record to see its approval state.

prompts.name: approve_or_unapprove_time_off
prompts.title: Approve or unapprove time off
prompts.description: Approve one time off record, so staff see it as approved. Remove the approval from the same record if needed.

prompts.name: clock_staff_in_or_out
prompts.title: Clock staff in or out
prompts.description: Clock a staff member in or out now, for payroll time. Photos and locations are not sent.
